title: To Be Black in Today’s America
description: A six-part series hosted by Jim Jeffords investigating the experiences of Black people in  Pennsylvania and the greater U.S.
quote: I witnessed firsthand the silent scourge of racism.
alt1: Black man wearing a fancy hat and holding a gasoline can in front of a purple car
alt3: Black man standing by the open window of a car with a white man and boy in the car, avoiding eye contact
alt4: black and white, inverted freeze frame of the white people in the car with text overlay that says, “the face of racism in America”
